data.case_title: Traffic fine (Bußgeldbescheid) from Brandenburg police – Az. BS-2026-772415.3
data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – Fine for illegal overtaking
data.summary: The Zentraldienst der Polizei Muster-Brandenburg (central Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Ronny Musterspree for illegally overtaking a lorry and endangering oncoming traffic on 2 October 2026. The total amount due is €182.00 (fine €150.00, fee €28.50, delivery costs €3.50) and 1 point is recorded in the driving register (Fahreignungsregister). The notice was delivered on 21 November 2026, starting the two-week period to file an objection (Einspruch).
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the Brandenburg police for a traffic violation (illegal overtaking). It sets a total of €182.00 to pay and adds 1 point to your driving record. You may file a written objection (Einspruch) with the issuing office if you disagree with the decision — the app shows you the deadline for this. If you do not object, the fine becomes final and the full amount becomes payable two weeks after that. Since money and points on your license are involved, review the facts carefully and consider legal advice if you intend to contest it.
